export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/bansal-wire-industries-limited): 'Total Shipments 8115 Records detected', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28'. Exact row quoted: '2026-02-28 | BANSAL WIRE INDUSTRIES LIMITED | WHL HC SPRING STEEL WIRE (OF THICKNESS ABOVE1.21 MM)- PATLI ICD INPTL6, India | Felixstowe, UNITED KINGDOM | 72171010 | BOL 1133885'. Second row: '2026-02-28 | ... CB STAINLESS STEEL WIRE (OF THICKNESS BELOW0.46 MM)- PATLI ICD INPTL6, India | Riga, LATVIA | 72230099 | BOL 1133443'. Third row: '2026-02-28 | ... CSL STAINLESS STEEL WIRE (OF THICKNESS 0.46MM TO 1.50 MM)- PATLI ICD INPTL6, India | New York, UNITED STATES | 72230092 | BOL 1142263'. Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 8115 total shipments / 119 trading partners / 100 ports; only 4 export rows were visible on the free view (3 distinct B/Ls quoted above), plus 5 supplier-side and 5 buyer-side aggregate rows. Destinations observed: UK, Latvia, USA (also Hamburg, Rotterdam, Mangalore ports listed).
domestic_evidence: Screener.in consolidated P&L (https://www.screener.in/company/BANSALWIRE/consolidated/): 'Sales 4,159' for Mar 2026 and '4,641' TTM (Rs crore), with quarterly sales '1,308' for Sep 2026 — i.e. large recurring domestic+export turnover booked in India. Company site (https://www.bansalwire.com/): 'we have a well-diversified base of more than 5,000 customers ... no single customer accounts for more than 5% of our sales' and 'pan India presence and our reach extends to more than 50 countries through product exports'. Screener key insights: 'Bansal Wire Inds 458,055 Total Sales Volume · Mar 2026', '680,000 Installed Capacity · Sep 2026', '5 Manufacturing Facilities'. Note: the annual report does not publish a clean domestic-vs-export revenue split in the free sources read, so the domestic share of the Rs 4,159 Cr FY26 revenue is not quantified here (null). No GeM/CPPP tender rows were retrieved (search tool was down).
note: Legal entity exists and is listed (BSE: 544209, NSE: BANSALWIRE) — no rejection grounds. Export shipments are factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records (28.02.2026, Patli ICD → Felixstowe UK, Riga Latvia, New York USA), so this is not a 'declared only' case. Declared HS codes 721391/721790/722300/831120 are consistent with observed records (72171010, 72230099, 72230092 all fall in the steel-wire family; 722300 matches exactly). Domestic supply is confirmed by audited-scale GST/turnover figures (Rs 4,159 Cr FY26 consolidated sales) and a stated 5,000+ customer pan-India base. Caveat: free ImportKey view showed only 4 of the claimed 8,115 shipment rows, so the full shipment history was not independently enumerated; the quoted rows are the evidence, not the counter. Revenue: Rs 4,159 Cr (FY Mar 2026, consolidated, Screener.in). Export volume in value/tonnage: null (not public in sources read).
